lines.en: I walk sideways with my claws open.
My shell is a burnt red.
Six legs land in turn on sand.
Each step throws a few sparks.
I move sideways along the water's edge.
My eyes sit out on stalks.
My claws click when they touch ground.
A scorch trail follows me.
Not fast, but hard to stop.
I walk sideways, so you can't easily flank me.
I turn, and I'm still sideways.
Sand sticks to my hot shell.
I raise a claw.
Only then do I lower it.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里停了一会儿
lines.en: I pause in the shallows.
Steam rises at my feet.
I draw my claws in front of me.
Red light shows between my shell's seams.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走进钳子的东西
lines.en: I wait for something to walk into my claws.
The water pushes away from my heat.
My eye stalks turn a full circle.
It's a little cool under the sand.
I keep still, saving heat.
Sparks drop slowly into the water.
My claws open and close.
Only steam rises from my shell.
The wind scatters the steam.
I turn my eyes back.
Good. Still nothing.
Then I go on waiting.

lines.zh: 我把两只眼睛都转过去
lines.en: I turn both eyes on you.
You're by the water with wet boots.

lines.zh: 我的钳子比你的手还大
lines.en: My claw is bigger than your hand.
My shell is still burning.
Except I walk sideways.
That hardly matters, really.
My shell stays hot.
One touch and you'll be burned.

lines.zh: 你的棍子敲不动这个壳
lines.en: That stick won't crack this shell.
I slowly lift a claw.
Water runs past my feet.
You move first, or I will.
Steam keeps rising at my feet.
A chip cracks off my shell.
I back two steps, sideways.
The light in my seams dims.
One claw hangs low.
Then I raise it again.
Steam puffs off the water.
That cost me a lot of speed.
You hit quite accurately.
But this shell is thick.
I can still close these claws once.
What are you putting in the water?
I need neither iron nor oil.
My heat covers the smell.
I touch it with a claw.
Burnt right through. No good.
Step back or the water will splash.
No interest. Take it away.
There's nothing good in this water.
I'll go back to walking sideways.
Don't block my path.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的壳上，被烫到
lines.en: You hit my shell and get burned.
My shell doesn't budge.
You back off, shaking your hand.
That splashes up wet sand.
A claw clips your leg.
Not heavy, but hot.
I shuffle half a step aside.
A puff of steam rises from the water.
My eye stalks stay pointed at you.
Touch again and the claws close.
Only I hold these shallows.
Crabs don't bother with such things.
If you stay, stand on dry ground.
I'm quicker in the water.
My shell stays hot.
Don't press that close.
At high tide I back up the shore.

lines.zh: 潮水上来时，我缩进洞里。
lines.en: When the tide rises, I back into my hole.
Come along if you can keep up.
If not, never mind.
I take it up in a claw.
Too hot. It chars in my claw.

lines.zh: 钳子一合，把它按进沙里。
lines.en: One clench of my claw presses it into sand.
Too small to grip.
You dropped it; it rolled to my feet.
I pick it up with the other claw.
This is hard. My claw won't crush it.
Useless things go back in the water.
Useful things I bury in the sand.
I'll come back for them.
You've walked to the water's edge.
I shuffle over sideways.
My claws are open.
Once they close, they won't loosen.
The water will drag at your feet.
My feet grip the sand.
My pincers are faster underwater.
I'm steadier in water.
The heat reaches your face first.
Then the claws.
I track you sideways.
You go left; I edge left.

lines.zh: 我的眼柄比我的身子高
lines.en: My eye stalks see over my body.
Going behind won't help.

lines.zh: 我横着走，两边都是正面
lines.en: Sideways, both sides face you.
My shell sits in the middle.
You raise a hand; I give half a step.
My claws stay open.

lines.zh: 你听得见壳缝的声音吗
lines.en: Hear the sound from my seams?
That's my shell burning.

lines.zh: 我的钳子夹住你的护腿
lines.en: My claw clamps your leg guard.
That's hot and tight at once.
You're pulled a step forward.
My other claw arrives.
My shell hits your knee, hard.
Our struggle sends up steam.
You grab an eye stalk.
I pull it in, fast.
That grip didn't close fully.
Again will be different.

lines.zh: 我从浅水里冒出来，冒着汽
lines.en: I rise from the shallows in steam.
Two scorch lines are left in the sand.
My shell is still red-hot.
The water hisses where I stand.
I take one step sideways.
These shallows will do for me.

lines.zh: 我低头把钳子浸了一下
lines.en: I dip a claw once.
White steam rises at once.
Then I lift it again.
There seems to be something ashore.
I turn both eyes that way.
And shuffle over sideways.
The fire burns along with my shell.
I land on sand, shell first.

lines.zh: 水深过我的壳，我往下沉
lines.en: Water covers my shell and I sink.
My shell flips over and my claws scrabble.

lines.zh: 箭撞上我的壳，歪了出去
lines.en: The arrow hits my shell and skews away.
That light went through my shell.
The fire in my shell has weakened.
Lightning comes through the water into my shell.
No sand. No water.
